drivingQuestion: Do service vessels sanctify only with intent?
outcomeNote: The inference is deflected by rereading the clause.

segments.he: וְנוֹתְנָהּ לִכְלֵי שָׁרֵת, וּמְקַדְּשָׁהּ בִּכְלִי שָׁרֵת. שָׁמְעַתְּ מִינַּהּ — כְּלִי שָׁרֵת אֵין מְקַדְּשִׁין אֶלָּא מִדַּעַת? אֵימָא: נוֹתְנָהּ בִּכְלִי שָׁרֵת לְקַדְּשָׁהּ בִּכְלִי שָׁרֵת.
segments.en: § The baraita states: «He places it in a service vessel and sanctifies it in» the «service vessel.» The Gemara asks: Can one «learn from» the unnecessary repetition of the term service vessel, that «service vessels can sanctify» their contents «only with intention?» Must one place the meal-offering in the service vessel with express intent to sanctify it? The Gemara answers: «Say: He» simply «places it in the service vessel» in order «to sanctify it in the service vessel.» He need not intend to sanctify it.
